div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Five prompts about product, audience, workflow, demo and constraints
All together with folded examples or one at a time with examples open

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Typing, dictation and optional graph preview
Keep focused card and answer options pinned while composing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicit submit only
Reconcile the whole turn, withdrawals and corrections

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Opening reviewer checks five rubrics
Extract grounded claims and propose relevant domains

div.style: color: rgb(21, 61, 50) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Versioned decisions and evidence
User turn, quote, source revision, rule and premise IDs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Catalog indexes by domain and criterion
Generic rubrics, prerequisites, risk and allowed rules

div.style: color: rgb(21, 61, 50) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Freeze scoped criteria and fact versions for this round
Include project prerequisites and shared domains

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Union and deduplicate eligible questions
Filter settled, deferred, already-open and out-of-scope items

div.style: color: rgb(68, 43, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Score each question by uncovered criterion IDs
Break ties by blocking criteria, then stable ID

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Positive gain and room in batch?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Take the winner and remove overlap from temporary set
Keep persistent criteria open until answered

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prepare selected questions and evidence only
Up to five, or two to three for a small change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
For a catalog gap adapt a nearby rubric or create one local question
Link to an evidenced criterion, deduplicate and apply round budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Small resolver proposes explicit, derived, partial, missing, conflict or delegation
Each criterion gets its own evidence and value

div.style: color: rgb(68, 43, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel checks schema, current source spans and permitted rules
Reject retractions, invalid proof chains and cycles

div.style: color: rgb(68, 43, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Independent meaning check on every derivation and costly explicit value
Difficult choices require a stated value or a bounded delegated choice

div.style: color: rgb(68, 43, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Queue one focused question for missing detail
Options, free text, recommendation or explanation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bind reply to question and scope revision
Keep siblings, reconcile obsolete cards and new steers

div.style: color: rgb(21, 61, 50) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Commit supported criteria and new evidence
Credit each once. A delegated but unchosen value stays open.

div.style: color: rgb(21, 61, 50) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Show total detail and planning readiness separately
Include inherited criteria and display critical open count

div.style: color: rgb(68, 43, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Nonempty current scope fully ready?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicitly deferred independent choice
Show milestone and block its consuming tasks until resolved

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Open known gaps in next round
Cap repeated generation and ask the highest-impact unresolved question

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Construct architecture and acceptance examples
Check cross-domain contracts, boundary cases and missing relations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Activate validated architecture, plan, task and test revision
Show the plan preview. The first build waits for Start build
